title: Wakhi language
description: Eastern Iranian language spoken by the Wakhi people
extract: Wakhi is an Eastern Iranic language within the Indo-Iranian branch of the Indo-European language family, spoken primarily by the Wakhi people native to the Wakhan District of northern Afghanistan, as well as neighboring areas of Pakistan, Tajikistan, and China.
